ABOUT ME

My name is Alex Levchenko, I'm is here to help you with repairs, installations, and assemblies of every kind. 
As a handyman, I stand behind my work. It is my objective to give you a reasonable price, enter your home or office, and complete the task at hand with excellence.
Call today for a free estimate.
Thank you.

​

* I'm not a licensed contractor

HAPPY CUSTOMERS

Alex did an awesome job! He arrived at time, brought all necessary instruments and quickly assembled my new dresser. The reason I chose him was excellent price/quality ratio and prompt response. I highly recommend him and will return to his service again

 

- Nataly, Brooklyn

We had a host of household tasks: TV mounting, replacing door hardware and switchplates, hanging a cabinet, and much much more. Alex was on time, super competent, really nice and thoughtful - and met our tight deadline. I couldn't recommend Alex more highly!

 

- James and Melissa, NY
